mapper.insert: insert into tb_order (coupon_id, user_id, user_name, phone, address, order_number, is_pay, pay_time, order_code, order_type, pack_money, errand_money, status, delete_flag, parent_user_id, shop_id, parent_id, create_time) values (#{couponId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{orderNumber}, #{isPay}, #{payTime}, #{orderCode}, #{orderType}, #{packMoney}, #{errandMoney}, #{status}, #{deleteFlag}, #{parentUserId}, #{shopId}, #{parentId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
select count(*) from tb_order where user_id = #{userId}
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select ifnull(sum(pay_money-ifnull(cancel_money,0)), 0) from tb_order where user_id = #{userId}
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
select tor.*, gs.shop_name as shopName from tb_order tor left join goods_shop gs on tor.shop_id = gs.shop_id where user_id = #{userId} and tor.status in (6, 3, 4, 5) order by pay_time desc

select ifnull(sum(pay_money-ifnull(cancel_money,0)), 0) from tb_order where status in (3,4)
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select count(*) from tb_order where status in (3,4)
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(pay_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
mapper.update: update tb_order set status = 4 where update_time < #{date} and status = 3
mapper.select: select * from tb_order where update_time < #{date} and status = 3
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM (SELECT user_id FROM tb_order t WHERE t.shop_id = #{shopId} GROUP BY t.user_id) AS t1
